steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I was treating this like a holiday in Laterano... Never thought something like this would happen.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Kjerag is a theocracy too, so why couldn't we have done this?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Laterano is much more influential. The Legati were all part of the Apostle's plan.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: We simply don't have that sort of foundation.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Influence, eh? It's only after leaving Kjerag that I learned how troublesome influence can be.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Pretty amazing how Enciodes managed to negotiate with our neighboring countries all on his own.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: The Saintess's influence is on the rise too. We have our own advantages.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But do you really think what the Lateran Pope is talking about is possible?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: I can't imagine a world where all the nations are so tightly entwined with one another. It sounds like a dream, or maybe a nightmare.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: But no one can ignore the miracle that happened that day, or the Pope's speech.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Is Laterano really the blessed city?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What do the Sankta think of all this, Ezell?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Huh? Well, er... it was stunning?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Figured as much. Apparently, that bell has not rung for thousands of years.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: So what will happen to Laterano now?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Perhaps not all that much, from what I know of the Laterans. Or maybe it's the same everywhere.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Turning points in history don't always seem so important at the time.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: But we do perceive that change is happening, and we'll take up our own duties and responsibilities.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Well said, brother.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You can leave us here. We have a car on the way.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: No problem. Cardinal Velliv is at a hospital not far from here. I'll be reporting back to her directly.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Please give her our thanks.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: As long as you're satisfied. Those were her instructions.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Nothing gets past her, huh?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Say, can you take a photo of me and my husband?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: How is that?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You're a pretty good photographer.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Say, Fiammetta, do you feel like your steps are heavier than usual?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Where's this coming from?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You don't feel a weight on your shoulders, after what His Holiness said?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Get to the point.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Well, I'm thinking I'm due for a career change. I'm not really cut out for a job with too much responsibility.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And you seem like just the girl to take my—

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: In your dreams.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Good afternoon.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Long time no see, Ezell.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: It's only been two weeks...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Are you on a mission?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: An errand on behalf of Cardinal Velliv. I was just about to report back to her.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: This is my final task in Laterano.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Not bad. Once you've seen the world, you'll realize how boring this place is.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There aren't as many great desserts out there, but... life is about more than just enjoyment, don't you think?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: So you're going to meet with Velliv? Where is she?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Stevonus Central Hospital.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Let's go together then. We're headed the same way.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Have you made up your mind?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Yes, I have.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I thought you'd need to mull it over a little longer.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I just felt that I can't be the only one standing still, while everyone else has already taken the next step.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Then I have nothing to add. I'm glad you accepted.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: It's wonderful to have someone like you join us, times being what they are.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I knew you'd be here, Velliv.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: How did you...?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: We ran into Ezell.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: The emissaries from Kjerag have reached their destination.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But don't leave just yet. I've got another task I could use your presence for.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: See you next week, Lemuen.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Have you decided to join the Seventh Tribunal, Lemuen?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Already on the job.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Hm, it won't be easy over there, after this conference.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Don't you think we're a match made in heaven though?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I suppose.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You've all chosen your paths. It's about time for me to think about what I can do too.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Speaking of, I was just talking to Fiammetta about quitting my job as a Legata.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Too much trouble?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I mean, with the old man? I can already see the trouble waiting in the future.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But you're not getting away that easily, Mostima. You answer to me now.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Here's your first job: bring this letter to El.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Can I say no?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Deliver it to her personally.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Unemployment is sounding more appealing by the second.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Quit it with the lame excuses.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And there's my old taskmaster.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You won't give up.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How can you be so sure?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Don't pretend that you don't need this job.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You're looking for an answer, aren't you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm not Andoain.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I didn't say you were.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But you have a choice to make, about who you are.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And to find that answer... one must have journeyed far enough.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: So how does it feel to be seen right through, Mostima? Sounds like you don't even need a halo to.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: This is my own path, then. You shouldn't follow me, Fiammetta.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You think the world revolves around you? We just happen to be taking the same road.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I have his gun.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: If he still sees himself as Sankta, he'll be back for it.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Then he'll pay for what he did!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And you'll help me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Fine...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: By the way, the Astray that were caught in the city have been set free.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Is that His Holiness's will?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: His mercy is none of my business.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I thought you might say something like that.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Oh, and you'll be dispatched to Rhodes Island under the agreement with the Notarial Hall, through the Fifth Tribunal.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Er, you mean the pharmaceutical company that Mostima and Lemuel work part-time at?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Where's this coming from?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Velliv wants to deepen our cooperation. You're as good as anyone for the role.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Plus, we have a good track record with them. You should be well-supported.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Oh, by the way, I have some really good news for you!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You get to choose from one of three code names for your next mission!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Do we really have to keep up this farce, now that you're our liaison?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: We only used a temporary name in the first place because there's no clear role for keeping tabs on her.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I've had enough of these monthly name changes!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Didn't you like Shimmering Vigil? What was it that you said... 'they've finally come up with a decent name'?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hey, nice flowers.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Hate to break it to you, but the tradition of changing your title has become a rule unto itself. Just accept it.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Here are your choices: Void Gourmet, Wasteland Pilot, or Dawn Destroyer.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: ...Dawn Destroyer.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Man, your tastes are so easy to guess.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I told you to shut up already!

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: *exhales*...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: You're awake?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Luck has really not been on my side lately.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: What's wrong? Getting bedsores from too much lying down?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: No, forget I said anything.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Huh? Ezell?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I wanted him to see what happens to those who come close to betraying Laterano.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Stop bullying the kid, Velliv.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Are you implying that I'm not young myself?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: You're no longer a Legatus.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: If that's the price I must pay, then...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But you're still my subordinate.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: ...it's a heavy one.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: You talk a big talk, Oren. Let's see what you learned in Victoria.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Does that mean you need me to do things my way?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Remember that question you asked? I can answer it now.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I have no interest in being a woman of integrity.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But I respect those who have worked hard to earn the title.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Well... I can't argue with that.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Was that intended for me as well?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Treasure the opportunity you've been given with Cecelia. Don't ever let me know what... influence she will have on Laterano.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You don't want her returning here?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: If I didn't, why would I waste time crafting an identity for her?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Other than, well, compassion. And the fact that she still has potential value that outweighs her risks.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Trust me, there's no harm in getting this sort of candid promise.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: No need to be nervous. I'm simply expressing Laterano's sincerity.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: If you two ever get tired of traveling, Laterano will be here.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Her doors will be open.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Federico?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Cardinal Velliv, here are the past two years of records regarding the activities of the former Legatus, Oren Argiolas.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Thank you, Executor Federico.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Just in case.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: There is reason to believe that Executor Richele may be his accomplice. Should I summon him?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: No need. He'll only claim to have been tricked by an old classmate, now won't he, Oren?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Remind me never to pick a fight with you again.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I'll let Richele be. For now.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But I would like to speak with him through you, when it's convenient. You don't have a problem with that, do you?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: N-No, not at all.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Then the two of them have been dealt with for the moment, Executor Federico.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Hold on, Federico.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I've been thinking. It couldn't have been easy to deduce that it was Feoria who met with the Sarkaz, just from a few sentences in a journal.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Why were you so obsessed?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Who were you seeking?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: ...Arturia.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Arturia... huh? Arturia?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The wanted criminal?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: What exactly is your relationship with her?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A distant relative.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Hahahaha!

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Seriously, man.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: If I could stand right now, I'd be dragging you to the nearest bar.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I don't have time.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You do, because I happened to run into an infamous fugitive a few years back. By the name of Arturia.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Wait! Calm down, Velliv!

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I wasn't looking for her! It was a coincidence!

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Seriously, I like to think of myself as a veteran, but just thinking back on that experience sends a shiver down my spine.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Where did you see her?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Three years ago, in Leithanien.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Richele...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: The paperwork is in order. She's now free to leave Laterano.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Thank you, Richele.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Just doing my job.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: You know where you're going, right?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Well, we'll meet up with Federico and join a company by the name of Rhodes Island under a cooperation agreement. Apparently, it's more convenient this way, since we'll be spending a lot of time outside.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Good. I've already contacted them.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: But you're still an executor of the Notarial Hall. Missions will be issued to you through Rhodes Island when it's inconvenient for you to return.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: That said, I have a hunch that your journey with her will go smoothly. You might find what you're looking for sooner rather than later.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: And my hunches are usually right.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Er, thanks?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I'll be going, then. Goodbye, Cecelia.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Bye-bye, Mister Richele.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Ah-choo!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Yikes. I'm getting a hunch that something bad's gonna happen...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Richele is an eccentric one too.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Hey, wait, how did he know that we're looking for something?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: What's wrong, Mister Ezell?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to say before we go?
The girl lets go of the young Sankta's hand and walks to the center of the flower field.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: (I'm leaving Laterano, Mamma.)

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: (But I'm not running away.)

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: (I'm gonna find Papà on my own, and tell him what you said.)

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: (I wanna see the outside world for myself... I wanna see Kazdel.)

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: (I'm happy, Mamma. Now, just like before...)

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: (Please, watch over me.)

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Can I pick a white flower?

steps.name: Sister
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You want to take this flower?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Fresh flowers won't last long. I can press it for you.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Will you teach me? I wanna learn for myself.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Thanks, Mister Ezell.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'm the one who should be thanking you.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Eh? Is that...?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Patia, are you really coming with me?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I was thinking you could stay here.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Laterano doesn't have what I'm looking for.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: What is it, Patia?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Excuse me, that was out of line.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: But... did you just smile?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Not to say that you don't normally—it's just that, well, something seems different.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: For many years, I thought we walked alone in the wilderness. I was arrogant and immature.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Did you hear the old man's speech?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I heard the second half when it woke me up. It was being broadcast all over the city. Loudly.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Yvangelista, the Patron Saint of Sacrifice and Unity. Perhaps he will go even further than the ten who took that name before him.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: What a grand, yet fragile vision.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: But one upon which I offer my blessings.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What did you learn that day?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: It's not important, Patia. Not so important, anyway.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Even if there is no reward waiting at the end of the journey, the act of continuing onward is, in itself, carrying the torch. Therefore, I will continue onward.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: We do not trade for blessings, nor for pity. We walk the path that we believe in.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Because... it is the only way to live with dignity, is it not?

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: We should depart, Guide, before the sun sets.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Let us go, my brothers and sisters.

a.text: The girl of mixed blood sees the leader take the first step.
The setting sun illuminates the halo on his head like a crown.
She recalls the stories of the Saints that her mother would tell her, and the word that her mother placed so much emphasis on.
She does not fully understand its meaning, or its symbolism. For some reason, though, it comes to mind when she sees that faraway figure.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: What are you looking at, Cecelia?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: No, nothing.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: The sunset is beautiful.

a.text: The girl looks about her, at the flowers, at the church, at the statue and the bell tower, so far away now.
She takes the young Sankta's hand, and the two of them begin to walk into the distance.
Her steps are slow, but she does not look back.
